remarks: This spectacular architect designed 5 Bedroom, 4 full Bath Contemporary is beautifully sited on an extraordinary and private 1.3 acre property with Pond, and just minutes to all of Westport's fabulous amenities and train Service to NYC. Tasteful renovations throughout 3700 square feet of living space offer dramatic, sun-filled interiors, Dining Room overlooking step-down Living Room with soaring ceiling, Fireplace, and access to expansive Deck, Office opening onto Screened Porch, Chef's Kitchen with Dining Area, private Primary Suite, Walk-out Lower Level with very versatile Great Room with Fireplace, Bedroom and Bath, an immaculate attached over-size Two-Car Garage with generous storage, and a Whole House Generator. First Floor: Foyer with random-width oak flooring, Guest Closet and access to Over-size attached Two-Car Garage. Dining Room with random-width oak flooring overlooking Step-down Living Room with random-width oak flooring, gas-log Fireplace, 2-story ceiling with Fan and Track Lighting, and twin Sliding Doors to expansive Deck. Chef's Kitchen with 12' ceilings and Skylight, oak flooring, Center Island Cook-top, timeless laminate Cabinetry, semi-circular Dining Area with wainscoting, and Built-in Desk. Wonderful Office/Bedroom with oak flooring, built-in Bookcases and Cabinetry, and sliding door to delightful Screened Porch. Full Hall Bath with oak flooring. Second Floor: Laundry Room with tile flooring. Bedroom with oak flooring.  PLEASE OPEN ADDENDUM.
